item.title: IndyCar on FOX to launch Iron Man Cam at St. Petersburg
item.description: FOX Sports is bringing more features to its IndyCar broadcasts this season, starting with something it loosely refers to as the "Iron Man Cam" which applies live graphics to its Driver’s Eye helmet camera feed.

item.title: Garzon perfect in St. Petersburg USF2000 opener
item.description: Colombian teenager Sebastian Garzon drove a perfect race for DEForce Racing on the streets of St. Petersburg.

item.description: The Whelen Mazda MX-5 Cup presented by Michelin paddock got quite the surprise on Friday morning when rookie Matt Novak (No. 11 Advanced Autosports) earned the Motul Pole Award for Round 3 at the Grand Prix of St. Petersburg. item.description: Considering how few laps Romain Grosjean has turned in IndyCar since departing the series at the end of 2024, there was no expectation for the returning Dale Coyne Racing driver to finish Friday at St. Petersburg sitting between Pato O’Ward, Josef Newgarden, and Scott Dixon on the timing board.Grosjean was...

item.title: Palou reaches unspecified settlement with McLaren, ending legal matter
item.description: Alex Palou and Chip Ganassi released coordinated statements on social media Friday morning with the recent participants in the Palou vs McLaren Racing lawsuit reaching an amicable conclusion to the lawsuit.

item.title: Firestone's offseason tire tweaks draw early praise
item.description: Tires were a big talking point in the IndyCar paddock on Friday at St. Petersburg.Firestone’s offseason efforts to make its street course primary compound take longer to warm up and last longer before notable degradation sets in appeared to be achieved. item.title: Cadillac names first F1 chassis after Mario Andretti
item.description: Although the team has since evolved and dropped the Andretti name from its title, ahead of Cadillac’s debut race it has confirmed its chassis will be the MAC-26 – or the Mario Andretti Cadillac 26.

item.title: Judge delays ruling on Gabehart's move to Spire Motorsports until Monday
item.description: No decision was made on JGR's petition to block Gabehart from moving forward with his role at Spire Motorsports by the conclusion of Friday's proceedings.

item.title: McLaughlin sets the benchmark in opening IndyCar practice at St. Petersburg
item.description: Team Penske's Scott McLaughlin got the 2026 IndyCar season rolling with the fastest time in Friday's practice session on the streets of St. Petersburg.
